oslo.text: Biggest T-bane shutdown ever starts today, through Sunday night. 63 of 101 stations closed, nothing through the centre, lines 4 and 5 fully shut. Only short western stretches: line 1 Frognerseteren–Frøen, line 2 Østerås–Makrellbekken, line 3 Kolsås–Ullernåsen.
Replacement buses 2B, 3B and 25B run to Majorstuen, tram 19x Majorstuen–centre, extra departures on 70E, 71, 76. Walk, cycle or work from home if you can.
Next 4-day closures: Feb 25–28, Mar 26–29, May 4–7, Jul 1–4, Aug 12–15 2027, plus one in Sep/Oct not dated.
Fornebubanen overrun of 7.3 bn kr would normally be covered through Oslopakke 3, usually meaning higher bompenger (road tolls). Nothing decided; city debates it in December.

be-aware.text: No weather warnings for Oslo or Østlandet today.
